What comes up in Oran Park

3 conditions, and each one is handled differently

Every site is scoped on the day. The table describes how these jobs generally go in this area. Your block may not match it, which is the reason for looking at it first.

Building platform to the civil design

Cut, fill and benching to bring a lot to the level and tolerance the engineer nominated.

How it is handled
Topsoil stripped first, the cut taken to design level, fill placed and compacted in layers, then the platform finished and left ready for set out.
What does it
Large excavator, roller, truck and dogs for both directions.

Pool and hardstand removal on an established block

As the earlier estate stock turns over, pools, sheds and concrete come out ahead of a renovation or a rebuild.

How it is handled
Shell broken out and removed, void backfilled with suitable material and compacted in layers rather than filled and covered.
What does it
Midi excavator with a hammer, tippers for the rubble and clean fill back in.

Slabs, footings and hardstand

What is left in the ground once the building is gone, and whether it comes out depends entirely on what is going on top of it.

How it is handled
Broken out with a hammer where it is coming out, or left and built over where the new design allows it. Worth settling with the builder before the quote rather than after.
What does it
Excavator with a hydraulic hammer, and a screening or grading bucket to finish the level.

Oran Park

What shapes the work on these blocks

  • New estate construction on former farmland Which makes earthworks, fill and site preparation the dominant work rather than knockdowns.
  • Established estate blocks are now maturing So pools, sheds and driveways are starting to come out alongside the greenfield work.
  • Levels set by the civil design And the job is quoted to that level rather than to a guess.
  • Clay rich soils Heavier and wetter than sand, slow to dry after rain, and classified differently when they leave.

Oran Park streets and blocks are new and generous, so plant and truck access are rarely the problem. What matters here is sequencing against the builder: a platform handed over at the wrong level or the wrong week costs more than the earthworks did.

Oran Park questions

What people ask before we start

Can you work to our civil engineer’s levels?
Yes, and that is how it should be quoted. Send the civil set or the engineer levels and the price is to a nominated platform level and tolerance rather than to a description.
What happens to the topsoil?
Stripped and stockpiled separately where it is being reused, or classified and carted where it is not. It is worth keeping it apart from what is underneath, because mixed material has fewer destinations and a higher rate.
Why does the haul distance matter out here?
Because the destination is set by what the material is classified as rather than by what is closest, and from the south west the licensed facility for a given classification can be a long way off. It is a real line in the price rather than a rounding error.
Who actually removes the asbestos?
Licensed asbestos removalists do the removal. Max holds demolition licence AD214737 and builds the programme around them, and an independent licensed assessor handles the air monitoring and the clearance. You are dealing with one contract rather than three.
